description: Direct prepaid packs: direct100c or direct1000 or direct10000. Lookups and availability stay free. Each agent identity gets 50 free tasks per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs 1 credit and a confirmed booking 5 credits. 1 credit = $0.10. Direct 100: 100 credits for $10; Direct 1,000: 1,000 credits for $90; Direct 10,000: 10,000 credits for $800. Credits never expire; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Existing prepaid dollar balances keep their full cent value; 10 cents of balance equals 1 credit. Quotes, settlement and agent-to-agent voice are not available. Returns a one-time Stripe checkout link for a prepaid pack; the customer opens it and pays on Stripe's own page, and this connection never sees the card. Only call it when the customer asked to buy, and tell them the price first. Products: 'formats' (Odile Formats credits; packs from get_catalog), 'minutes' (meeting minutes, only where Meeting Notes is on), 'line_minutes' (phone minutes for a new After Hours line; line_id required: min40: 40 minutes for $10; min200: 200 minutes for $50), 'line_outcomes' (resolved conversations for an outcome line; line_id required: out50: 50 resolved conversations for $24.50; out200: 200 resolved conversations for $98), 'photos' (Plate API photo credits: starter: 1000 photos for $10; growth: 5000 photos for $45; scale: 20000 photos for $160), 'calls' (legacy per-call lines only). What was paid is added within a minute of payment, whatever device paid it. Nothing renews. Needs a signed-in connection with the billing:checkout permission. Returns { checkout_url, product, pack, price_cents, units, unit, then }.
